lexicalDecisions.decision: One necessary new冶金やきん article, noun metallurgy, supports exactヤ. Related冶金学,冶金学者,冶工 and粉末冶金 confirm the technical family but do not require four extra articles. Keep all raw flags; dictionary priority is not a measured frequency or JLPT level.
Standalone冶や noun melting is documented but less useful here than the technical compound. No extra article or claim it is an ordinary everyday standalone verb.

Preserve complete smithing families. 鍛冶かじ is flagged gikun/jukujikun;たんや is separately documented;かぬち is obsolete reading information. 鍛治 is irregular and several later aliases are search-only. 鍛冶屋 also has a colloquial usually-kana crowbar sense. Do not derive aジ metadata reading, use these asい.る examples or equate every branch with the technical discipline.
治具/冶具ジグ means a jig/tool and is usually kana, with ateji flags and irregular冶具. Not an ordinary冶 sound-allocation example or a reason to change frozen readings.
陶冶とうや includes cultivation/training and making pottery/casting metal. Brief recognition may show the figurative branch, but no new陶冶 article or sweeping claim that冶 only means literal melting.

遊冶郎 and艷冶 preserve non-metal senses. The frozen艷 spelling and alluring senses are evidence, not useful practice targets for this bounded card; do not infer modern frequency from absent flags or introduce an unverified primary spelling.

comparisonDecisions.decision: Existing金属きんぞく names metal as a material/category; proposed冶金やきん names the science/technology. 金ぞく is search-only. Their actual labels metal/metallurgy are distinct, not an automatic exclusion pair.

Retain complete refining/smelting, iron-making, forging/training and casting families. 精錬's training sense is restricted to精錬/精煉, not製錬;精煉 is rare spelling. 鑄る is outdated spelling. These processes relate to metallurgy but are not interchangeable with its entire field. No current exact article exists for these four candidates; do not add them merely for comparison.

Actual溶かす/溶ける articles and full families cover transitive/intransitive melting, dissolving and informal financial uses. They are not冶 spelling evidence. Avoid presenting冶 as the usual spelling for melting butter, snow or sugar. Existing溶 has three semantically wrong curated distractors, so no established legacy default-four-choice repair.
Actual治めるおさめる and治 character card concern governing/settling;治 is a useful shape contrast, not an interchangeable spelling of冶 in this support word. Preserve existing identities and levels.
